name: Zheng-Dao Bioelectric Galvanic Carapace Shell
description:
The Galvanic Carapace Shell is a reactive body armor system developed by Zheng-Dao Bioelectric that integrates a layered bioelectric charge matrix beneath a semi-rigid ceramic composite exterior. When the outer shell absorbs kinetic or thermal impact, piezoelectric transducers convert the energy into a directed galvanic discharge across the armor's surface, creating a localized electric shock field that punishes close-contact attackers and disrupts electronic targeting systems in immediate proximity. The charge cycles reset within 1.4 seconds under normal load, providing near-continuous deterrence against melee engagement.

What distinguishes the Carapace Shell from conventional reactive plating is its symbiotic relationship with the wearer's own bioelectric field. Zheng-Dao's proprietary Dermosync calibration layer reads the operator's skin conductivity and autonomic nervous responses, adjusting discharge thresholds to avoid self-harm during perspiration or stress. The outer shell itself has a faintly iridescent, oil-slick finish caused by the conductive polymer mesh just beneath the surface coating — a visual signature that experienced street operators recognize immediately.

Primarily adopted by corporate security details operating in close-quarters environments such as server vaults, executive transit corridors, and bioresearch facilities, the Carapace Shell has also found significant uptake among mid-tier gang enforcers who acquire surplus units through gray-market channels. It is considered both practical armor and a status symbol in certain criminal strata — wearing one signals that you've survived enough encounters to afford real protection.

specifications.self_harm_threshold_override: Dermosync auto-cutoff below 800V at skin contact

tactical_use: Operators wearing the Galvanic Carapace Shell are trained to invite close engagement, allowing the reactive discharge to disable or deter melee combatants. The shell's electronic disruption field also creates a 0.8-meter interference bubble that degrades drone micro-guidance systems and wireless detonation signals, making it valuable in breaching scenarios. Security teams often pair it with non-conductive gloves and boots to avoid grounding the discharge.
cultural_context: In GLMZ's corporate security culture, the Galvanic Carapace Shell is shorthand for 'serious money and serious threat.' Wearing one in a negotiation context is considered an implicit statement of intent. Among street-level operators, a scuffed or partially repaired Carapace Shell — the iridescent finish scratched and dulled from use — is worn as a badge of survival. Zheng-Dao has leaned into this, releasing a limited 'Field-Worn' aesthetic finish that mimics battle damage.
story_hooks: A batch of Galvanic Carapace Shells with a faulty Dermosync calibration layer has been sold on the black market — wearers are suffering cardiac events during high-stress situations.
A Zheng-Dao whistleblower claims the Dermosync layer is transmitting biometric data back to corporate servers, allowing the company to track and physiologically profile every registered user.

A gang war has erupted in the GLMZ industrial district because one faction suddenly acquired a shipment of Carapace Shells, fundamentally shifting the balance of power in close-quarters territory disputes.
The players need to retrieve a Carapace Shell from a deceased corporate agent — but the Dermosync layer has locked to the dead wearer's biometric profile and is cycling random discharges.

physical_description.visual_profile: A form-fitting reactive body armor system consisting of overlapping ceramic composite plates with a distinctive oil-slick iridescent sheen. The segmented plating follows the torso and shoulder musculature, with articulated upper-arm sections that allow mobility. The surface ripples subtly with embedded conductive polymer mesh visible beneath a semi-transparent protective coating, creating an almost organic, scaled appearance despite its technological nature.
physical_description.dimensions: Torso coverage spans approximately 45cm height × 38cm width; shoulder pauldrons extend 20cm laterally; upper arm sections wrap 28cm circumference. Overall backpack-sized when assembled, but worn as a second skin.
physical_description.weight_description: 8.4 kg total — distributed across the torso and shoulders. Handheld during fitting, but weight-balanced to feel lighter during wear due to its ergonomic conformity. Requires a harness system for proper load distribution.
physical_description.primary_material: Semi-rigid ceramic composite (outer shell) with embedded piezoelectric transducers; conductive polymer mesh layer beneath; bioelectric charge matrix distributed through microchannel pathways integrated into structural ribbing.
physical_description.finish: Matte ceramic with iridescent oil-slick sheen caused by the underlying conductive mesh. Surface appears to shift between dark blues, purples, and metallic greens depending on angle and light. Slightly textured grip zones on impact-optimized areas.
physical_description.color_scheme: Midnight black ceramic base with iridescent conductive mesh creating shifting blue-violet-bronze undertones. Accent strips of reflective safety-grade phosphor stripe along seams (required by GLMZ workplace safety codes). Faint cyan glow from internal status LEDs visible at edge seams during active operation.
physical_description.interface_elements: Right-shoulder mounted control interface: small raised panel with three tactile buttons for charge mode selection (passive/active/diagnostic). Wrist-side port (reinforced USB-C analog) for Dermosync calibration. Status LED strip running along the right side seam — indicates charge cycle readiness (blue = ready, amber = cooling, red = fault). Haptic feedback nodes distributed across inner surface where it contacts skin.
distinctive_features: Oil-slick iridescent sheen that shifts color with movement and light angle — signature visual marker of Zheng-Dao bioelectric tech
Faint crackling aura visible around edges during high-voltage discharge events
Micro-articulated plate segments that move independently with torso flexion
Subtle cyan glow emanating from seam gaps when active
Organic scaling appearance despite synthetic construction — intentional biomimetic design language
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ZHENG-DAO BIOELECTRIC logo (stylized circuit-heart symbol) embossed on right shoulder in raised chrome. Serial number and batch code laser-etched on inner left torso seam. Regulatory stamps: GLMZ approval seal, NIJ Level IIIA equivalent rating label, bioelectric hazard warning (skull with electrical bolts) on shoulder pauldron. Warranty void if opened; tamper-evident hologram seal present at battery access port.
physical_description.condition_typical: In active use: faint cyan glow at seams, subtle warmth radiating from ceramic (thermal dissipation), micro-vibrations felt against skin during discharge cycles. Under examination: iridescent finish catches light dramatically; inner Dermosync calibration layer visible through access panel shows fine silver trace pathways. Worn gear shows scuff marks on impact zones, slight discoloration from sweat/saltwater buildup along contact points despite hydrophobic coating.

image_prompt: Product photography of a Zheng-Dao Bioelectric Galvanic Carapace Shell body armor displayed on a sleek steel workbench with industrial neo-noir aesthetic. The armor is positioned at three-quarter angle to showcase its iridescent oil-slick ceramic plating that shifts between dark blue, violet, and metallic bronze. Dramatic overhead lighting casts sharp shadows across the segmented plate structure, while a secondary blue-tinted accent light from the left illuminates the subtle cyan glow emanating from seam edges, suggesting active bioelectric charge matrix. The background is a soft-focus bokeh of neon signs (Mandarin characters, electrical symbols) and diffused tungsten lighting. Shallow depth of field focuses on the right shoulder control panel and its three tactile buttons. The ceramic surface captures light like oil on water, creating a mesmerizing iridescent shimmer. Include a small product label placard reading 'ZHENG-DAO BIOELECTRIC — GALVANIC CARAPACE SHELL' with circuit-heart logo.
